headline: MIN @ TEX matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIN 4.39 at TEX 4.55, with a projected total of 8.94. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIN: MIN moved +1.32 runs while TEX moved +0.43, changing the projected margin by +0.89 runs. The projected total climbed +1.75, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -9.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: MacKenzie Gore has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Josh Jung, Kody Clemens, Byron Buxton, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Austin Martin because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
